def smd.ownMF_empty.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : Loc), ownMap m (DFrac.own 1) ∅ ⊢ smd.ownMF m smd.MF.none

def smd.nodesLookup (pe : smd.PE) : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) → Option smd.Trie :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (smd.nodesLookup._f pe)

def smd.FSet.card_union.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a b : smd.FSet α), (a.union b).card ≤ a.card + b.card

def smd.isPEs_app.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (es es' : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (p p' : smd.Path),
    es.length = List.length p → smd.isPEs (es ++ es') (p ++ p') ⊣⊢ smd.isPEs es p ∗ smd.isPEs es' p'

def smd.PathSet.prepend (pre : smd.Path) (S : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.map (fun q => pre ++ q) S

def smd.PathSet.mem_tops.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.PathSet) (e : smd.PE), e ∈ S.tops ↔ [e] ∈ S

def smd.isPathF (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (p : smd.Path) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ es, ownSlice s es dq ∗ smd.isPEs es p)

def smd.PathSet.mem_ofList.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (ps : List smd.Path) (q : smd.Path), q ∈ smd.PathSet.ofList ps ↔ q ∈ ps ∧ q ≠ []

def smd.isPEs_cons.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement)
    (es : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (pe : smd.PE) (p : List smd.PE),
    smd.isPEs (e :: es) (pe :: p) ⊣⊢ smd.isPE e pe ∗ smd.isPEs es p

def smd.Trie.empty : smd.Trie :=
  smd.Trie.mk [] []

def smd.PathSet.nodes (S : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.bind smd.Path.nePrefixes S

def smd.PathSet.mem_rdiff.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (A B : smd.PathSet) (q : smd.Path), q ∈ A.rdiff B ↔ q ∈ A ∧ ∀ (r : smd.Path), r ∈ q.nePrefixes → ¬r ∈ B

def smd.instDecidableLt (a b : smd.PE) : Decidable (a.lt b) :=
  smd.instDecidableLt._aux_1 a b

def (sealed) smd.ownPEMapV (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementMap) (M :
    smd.PEMap GoInterface) : IProp GF

def smd.FSet.cardLt_mono.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a b : smd.FSet α) (n m : Nat),
    (∀ (x : α), x ∈ a → x ∈ b) → n ≤ m → b.CardLt n → a.CardLt m

def smd.PathSet.mem_prepend.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (pre : smd.Path) (S : smd.PathSet) (q : smd.Path), q ∈ smd.PathSet.prepend pre S ↔ ∃ r, r ∈ S ∧ q = pre ++ r

def smd.PEMap.HasCard {α : Type} (M : smd.PEMap α) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ l, l.Nodup ∧ (∀ (k : smd.PE), k ∈ l ↔ (M k).isSome = true) ∧ l.length = n

def smd.PE.sorted_ext.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (xs ys : List smd.PE),
    (∀ (x : smd.PE), x ∈ xs → x.wf = true) →
      (∀ (y : smd.PE), y ∈ ys → y.wf = true) →
        smd.PE.Sorted xs → smd.PE.Sorted ys → (∀ (x : smd.PE), x ∈ xs ↔ x ∈ ys) → xs = ys

def smd.FSet.CardLt {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (s : smd.FSet α) (b : Nat) : Prop :=
  s.card < b

def smd.PathSet.mem_deep.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.PathSet) (q : smd.Path), q ∈ S.deep ↔ q ∈ S ∧ 2 ≤ List.length q

def smd.isNodes (l : Loc) (D : smd.PathSet) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ m, typedPointsto l m DFrac.discard ∗ smd.isNodesV m D)

def smd.FSet.mem_diff.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a b : smd.FSet α) (x : α), x ∈ a.diff b ↔ x ∈ a ∧ ¬x ∈ b

def smd.PathSet.heads (S : smd.PathSet) : smd.FSet smd.PE :=
  smd.FSet.bind
    (fun q =>
      match q with
      | e :: head :: tail => [e]
      | x => [])
    S

def smd.PE.compare_eq_zero.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : smd.PE), a.wf = true → b.wf = true → (a.compare b = 0 ↔ a = b)

def smd.isPESet (l : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (S : smd.FSet smd.PE) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v, typedPointsto l v dq ∗ smd.isPESetV v dq S)

def smd.ownPESetV_zero.law : Prop :=
  True ⊢ smd.ownPESetV (zero_val sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementSet) smd.FSet.empty

def smd.PE.compare_trans.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b c : smd.PE), a.wf = true → b.wf = true → c.wf = true → a.lt b → b.lt c → a.lt c

def smd.PathSet.mem_under.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.PathSet) (e : smd.PE) (q : smd.Path), q ∈ S.under e ↔ q ≠ [] ∧ e :: q ∈ S

def smd.PEMap.CardLt {α : Type} (M : smd.PEMap α) (b : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ (n : Nat), M.HasCard n → n < b

def smd.isNodes_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (l : Loc) (D : smd.PathSet), smd.isNodes l D ⊢ □ smd.isNodes l D

def smd.isSet_split.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (S : smd.PathSet),
    smd.isSet p S ⊢
      smd.isPESet
          (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Set'
            go!"Members" p)
          DFrac.discard S.tops ∗
        smd.isNodes
          (structFieldRef sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.Set'
            go!"Children" p)
          S.deep

def smd.isPE_wf.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (pe : smd.PE), smd.isPE e pe ⊢ ⌜pe.wf = true⌝

def smd.ownMF_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.ManagedFields) (mf : smd.MF), smd.ownMF m mf ⊢ |==> smd.isMF m mf

def smd.PEMap.empty {α : Type} : smd.PEMap α :=
  none

def smd.isVSet_concrete.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.VersionedSet) (e : smd.VSet),
    smd.isVSet i e ⊢ ∃ v, ⌜i = interface.mkOk sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.versionedSet.ty (intoVal v)⌝

def smd.Path.nePrefixes (q : smd.Path) : List smd.Path :=
  List.map (fun k => List.take (k + 1) q) (List.range (List.length q))

def smd.isPE_agree.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (e : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (a b : smd.PE), smd.isPE e a ∗ smd.isPE e b ⊢ ⌜a = b⌝

def (sealed) smd.ownPEVMapV (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementValueMap)
    (M : smd.PEMap sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) : IProp GF

def smd.FSet.HasCard {α : Type} (s : smd.FSet α) (n : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ l, l.Nodup ∧ smd.FSet.ofList l = s ∧ l.length = n

def smd.PathSet.rdiff (A B : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.filter (fun q => !q.nePrefixes.any fun r => smd.FSet.mem B r) A

def (sealed) smd.ownPESetV (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementSet) (S :
    smd.FSet smd.PE) : IProp GF

def smd.FSet.hasCard_zero.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} (a : smd.FSet α) (n : Nat), a.HasCard n → (n = 0 ↔ a.isEmpty = true)

def smd.ownPESetV_read.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementSet) (S : smd.FSet smd.PE),
    smd.ownPESetV v S ⊢ ∃ dq, smd.isPESetV v dq S ∗ (smd.isPESetV v dq S -∗ smd.ownPESetV v S)

def smd.FSet.mem_ofList.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (l : List α) (x : α), x ∈ smd.FSet.ofList l ↔ x ∈ l

def smd.PE.compare_antisymm.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (a b : smd.PE), a.wf = true → b.wf = true → (a.compare b < 0 ↔ 0 < b.compare a)

def smd.isPEs_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (es : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (p : smd.Path),
    smd.isPEs es p ⊢ □ smd.isPEs es p

def smd.isPESetV_persistent.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementSet) (S : smd.FSet smd.PE),
    smd.isPESetV v DFrac.discard S ⊢ □ smd.isPESetV v DFrac.discard S

def smd.ownMF_access.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.ManagedFields) (mf : smd.MF),
    smd.ownMF m mf ⊢
      ∃ M,
        ownMap m (DFrac.own 1) M ∗
          ⌜smd.keysSorted mf = true ∧ ∀ (k : GoString), (M !! k).isSome = (mf.get k).isSome⌝ ∗
            (□ ∀ k i e, ⌜M !! k = some i ∧ mf.get k = some e⌝ -∗ smd.isVSet i e) ∗
              ∀ M' mf',
                ownMap m (DFrac.own 1) M' -∗
                  ⌜smd.keysSorted mf' = true ∧ ∀ (k : GoString), (M' !! k).isSome = (mf'.get k).isSome⌝ -∗
                    (□ ∀ k i e, ⌜M' !! k = some i ∧ mf'.get k = some e⌝ -∗ smd.isVSet i e) -∗ smd.ownMF m mf'

def smd.ownPESetV_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementSet) (S : smd.FSet smd.PE),
    smd.ownPESetV v S ⊢ |==> smd.isPESetV v DFrac.discard S

def smd.PEMap (α : Type) : Type :=
  smd.PE → Option α

def smd.isSet_ne.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (S : smd.PathSet), smd.isSet p S ⊢ ⌜¬[] ∈ S⌝

def smd.ownPEMap (l : Loc) (M : smd.PEMap GoInterface) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v, typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ smd.ownPEMapV v M)

def smd.isValF_isValuePtr.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) (dq : DFrac) (x : smd.UVal),
    smd.isValF v dq x ⊢ ⌜smd.isValuePtr v⌝

def smd.PathSet.tops (S : smd.PathSet) : smd.FSet smd.PE :=
  smd.FSet.bind
    (fun q =>
      match q with
      | [e] => [e]
      | x => [])
    S

def smd.PE.wf : smd.PE → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | smd.PE.key fl => List.all fl fun f => f.snd.canon
  | smd.PE.value v => v.canon
  | x => true

def smd.isPathF_persist.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (p : smd.Path), smd.isPathF s dq p ⊢ |==> smd.isPath s p

def (sealed) smd.ownNodesT (l : Loc) (cs : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)) : IProp GF

def smd.isValuePtr (x : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, x = interface.mkOk sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.valueUnstructured.ty.PointerType (intoVal p)

def smd.instDecidableCardLt {α : Type} [DecidableEq α] (s : smd.FSet α) (b : Nat) : Decidable
    (s.CardLt b) :=
  smd.instDecidableCardLt._aux_1 s b

def smd.FSet.hasCard_exists.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} (a : smd.FSet α), ∃ n, a.HasCard n

def smd.isPEs_length.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (es : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (p : smd.Path),
    smd.isPEs es p ⊢ ⌜es.length = List.length p⌝

def smd.FSet.mem_bind.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α β : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : DecidableEq β] (f : α → List β) (a : smd.FSet α) (y : β),
    y ∈ smd.FSet.bind f a ↔ ∃ x, x ∈ a ∧ y ∈ f x

def smd.ownSet_ne.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (p : Loc) (S : smd.PathSet), smd.ownSet p S ⊢ ⌜¬[] ∈ S⌝ ∗ smd.ownSet p S

def smd.nodesSet (pe : smd.PE) (t : smd.Trie) : List (smd.PE × smd.Trie) → List (smd.PE × smd.Trie)
    :=
  List.brecOn x✝ (smd.nodesSet._f pe t)

def smd.FSet.hasCard_unique.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} (a : smd.FSet α) (n m : Nat), a.HasCard n → a.HasCard m → n = m

def (sealed) smd.isNodesV (m : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.SetNodeMap) (D :
    smd.PathSet) : IProp GF

def smd.PEMap.insert {α : Type} (M : smd.PEMap α) (k : smd.PE) (v : α) : smd.PEMap α :=
  if k' = k then some v else M k'

def smd.PathSet.card_nodes.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.PathSet), smd.FSet.card S ≤ smd.FSet.card S.nodes

def smd.FSet.mem_filter.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (p : α → Bool) (a : smd.FSet α) (x : α),
    x ∈ smd.FSet.filter p a ↔ x ∈ a ∧ p x = true

def smd.FSet.isEmpty_iff.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a : smd.FSet α), a.isEmpty = true ↔ ∀ (x : α), ¬x ∈ a

def smd.FSet.mem_union.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a b : smd.FSet α) (x : α), x ∈ a.union b ↔ x ∈ a ∨ x ∈ b

def smd.PE.lt (a b : smd.PE) : Prop :=
  a.compare b < 0

def smd.PathSet.mem_heads.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (S : smd.PathSet) (e : smd.PE), e ∈ S.heads ↔ ∃ q, q ≠ [] ∧ e :: q ∈ S

def (sealed) smd.isPESetV (v : sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElementSet) (dq :
    DFrac) (S : smd.FSet smd.PE) : IProp GF

def smd.ownPEVMap (l : Loc) (M : smd.PEMap sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.value.Value) : IProp
    GF :=
  iprop(∃ v, typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ smd.ownPEVMapV v M)

def smd.PE.Sorted (xs : List smd.PE) : Prop :=
  List.Pairwise smd.PE.lt xs

def smd.isPath_isPathF.law : Prop :=
  ∀ (s : GoSlice) (p : smd.Path), smd.isPath s p ⊣⊢ smd.isPathF s DFrac.discard p

def smd.FSet.mem_inter.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a b : smd.FSet α) (x : α), x ∈ a.inter b ↔ x ∈ a ∧ x ∈ b

def smd.isPEs_nil.law : Prop :=
  True ⊢ smd.isPEs [] []

def smd.FSet.hasCard_card.law : Prop :=
  ∀ {α : Type} [inst : DecidableEq α] (a : smd.FSet α), a.HasCard a.card

def smd.ownPESet (l : Loc) (S : smd.FSet smd.PE) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ v, typedPointsto l v (DFrac.own 1) ∗ smd.ownPESetV v S)

def smd.PathSet.deep (S : smd.PathSet) : smd.PathSet :=
  smd.FSet.filter (fun q => decide (2 ≤ List.length q)) S

def (sealed) smd.isPEs (es : List sigs_k8s_io.structured_merge_diff.v7.fieldpath.PathElement) (p :
    smd.Path) : IProp GF
